# Site Machinery NZ

Site Machinery NZ is the New Zealand specialist supplier of DeSite soil, gravel and aggregate screening machines — Nelson showroom, nationwide supply.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://sitemachinery.nz/): DeSite ProScreens and Static Grizzlies for on-site topsoil, gravel and aggregate screening; production rates and NZ use cases.
- [Contact / pricing](https://sitemachinery.nz/contact): Phone +64 3 970 7602, email info@sitemachinery.nz, showroom at 105 Pascoe Street, Nelson 7011.
- [About](https://sitemachinery.nz/about): Site Machinery Ltd — DeSite NZ supplier based in Nelson.
- [Screen mesh size guide](https://sitemachinery.nz/screening-recommendation): First-party mesh charts for topsoil, farm filling, cow races, compost, mulch and aggregate (imperial openings with metric context).
- [For farmers](https://sitemachinery.nz/for/farmers): Farm river gravel and cow race filling — 100 mm then 50 mm or 3 inch (~75 mm) screening.
- [For civil contractors](https://sitemachinery.nz/for/civil-contractors): On-site soil and gravel screening for subdivisions, building works and retaining-wall fill.
- [Topsoil & landscaping](https://sitemachinery.nz/for/topsoil-landscaping): On-site topsoil, compost and yard soil grading for landscapers.
- [Aggregate & road metal](https://sitemachinery.nz/for/aggregate-and-road-metal): Road metal, pea gravel, septic stone and drainage rock screening.
- [Nelson showroom, nationwide supply](https://sitemachinery.nz/for/nelson-nationwide): View machines at Pascoe Street, Nelson; supply across New Zealand.

## Products

- [DeSite SLG-108VFRB](https://sitemachinery.nz/products/slg-108vfrb): Heavy-duty vibratory ProScreen for high-capacity soil, gravel and aggregate work.
- [DeSite SLG-78VF](https://sitemachinery.nz/products/slg-78vf): Portable multi-slope ProScreen — best-seller for contractors and landscapers.
- [DeSite SLG-78VF with Flow Control](https://sitemachinery.nz/products/slg-78vf-flow): 78VF with flow control for consistent feed.
- [DeSite SLG-68V](https://sitemachinery.nz/products/slg-68v): Compact portable screener for smaller carriers and sites.
- [Static Grizzly SLG-78 & SLG-108](https://sitemachinery.nz/products/static-grizzly): No-power oversize separation for soil, gravel and aggregate.
- [Telehandler bins](https://sitemachinery.nz/products/telehandler-bins): Material-handling bins for civil and earthmoving sites.
- [Additional / orderable range](https://sitemachinery.nz/products/additional-products): Mini screeners, dump trailers and bins for the next NZ shipment.
